name: Sourhogs

variantInfo.name: Sourhog
notes: The Sourhog has 40 Hitpoints, a 5-tick attack, and gives 40 Slayer XP. Its normal melee/ranged max hit is 6.
Without Reinforced goggles (or a Slayer helmet after the quest), the Sourhog's caustic saliva hits 20-30 and drains Attack and Defence by 90% - wear eye protection.
Best attacked with a stab or ranged weapon: its Defence has +0 stab and +0 ranged bonuses but +30 slash and +30 magic.

locationComparison.name: Sourhog Cave (Draynor)
notes: Sourhog Cave, south of Draynor Village, is only accessible after starting A Porcine of Interest.
No single canonical spawn count is wiki-stated (honest UNKNOWN), so no amount overlay is authored.

taskNotes: Sourhogs are assigned ONLY by Spria (Turael stopped assigning them in the May 2024 update); it is Spria's sole distinguishing task.
Requires the quest A Porcine of Interest to access Sourhog Cave; there is no combat or Slayer level requirement.
slayerTargetId 303 is SYNTHETIC (c2-c3-worklist section 1 allocation contract); the real SLAYER_TARGET varp value is a QA live-verify item.
The Sourhog (level 37) has 40 Hitpoints, Defence level 25, a normal max hit of 6, and gives 40 Slayer XP.

Wear Reinforced goggles (requiredItemId 24942, wiki item infobox id) or a Slayer helmet after the quest: without eye protection the caustic saliva hits 20-30 and drains Attack and Defence by 90%. offence.maxHit pins this 30 worst-case survival number, not the 6 normal hit.
No elemental weakness; its Defence bonuses are +0 stab and +0 ranged (best) versus +30 slash and +30 magic, so a stab or ranged weapon is most accurate.
No task extension unlock exists for Sourhogs.
recommendedMethod: Start A Porcine of Interest to reach Sourhog Cave south of Draynor, and always wear Reinforced goggles (or a Slayer helmet after the quest) so the caustic saliva cannot hit 20-30 and drain your stats. Attack the Sourhog with a stab weapon such as a dragon dagger (its Defence is +0 to stab, +30 to slash); ranged is a solid alternative against its +0 ranged Defence.
